data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $11.80 for fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), up from $9.68 in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023), an increase of about 21.9%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $88.1 billion, compared with $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023, a rise of roughly 22%. These figures come from my recollection of Microsoft's reported results rather than a live lookup of the filings, so confirm them against the fiscal 2024 Form 10-K if precision matters.
